channel.title: Financial Express - Latest News
channel.description: Real-time breaking business and financial news.

item.title: AI forces IT firms to rethink cybersecurity
item.description: Following recent data breaches, top Indian IT firms are broadening Zero Trust frameworks to secure AI applications, agents, and APIs against prompt injection and accidental leaks.

item.title: Florida bans undocumented students from CTE programmes: What the new rule means
item.description: The Florida Board of Education banned undocumented students from career and technical education programs, extending restrictions following the block on undocumented enrollment in state universities. This impacts thousands of immigrant students.

item.title: Tata Trusts step up battle as legal heavyweights join
item.description: Singhvi: SC defended Tata Sons’ Articles of Association

item.title: Kavach 4.0 in Lucknow Division: How Rs 252-crore project will strengthen train safety
item.description: Indian Railways to deploy Kavach Version 4.0 across 607.7 route km in Lucknow Division, North Eastern Railway, with Rs 252 crore funding to enhance train safety and prevent signal passing accidents.

item.title: HFCs seek wider pool of long-term funding
item.description: Want greater participation from insurers, pension funds as long-tenure capital remains scarce

item.title: How real is India’s growth?
item.description: Some of the concerns have come about from a lack of transparency with respect to methods and the raw data, but it does seem India is growing fast

item.title: Wanted: fresher; 3 years’ experience essential
item.description: Indian IT’s “experience creep” is quietly requiring fresh engineering graduates to have years of project experience as AI replaces traditional entry-level work and bench roles.

item.title: Delhi is outside global top 100 today, but its GDP could surge by $1.8T by 2050: Report
item.description: Delhi is poised to become a global economic powerhouse by 2050, adding $1.8 trillion in GDP alongside the rise of Bengaluru and other Indian cities transforming the urban economic landscape.

item.title: India’s defence production hits Rs 1.78 lakh crore: Who stands to gain from the boom?
item.description: India exported defence equipment worth Rs 38,424 crore in FY2025-26, according to the Ministry of Defence.

item.title: Mend the guarantor process
item.description: Design issues in personal guarantor insolvency proceedings demand reforms

item.title: Tariff shock, again
item.description: Prospective duties for buying Russian oil make the Indo-US trade deal elusive

item.title: ‘New series GDP estimates are likely to be significantly more stable’: Saurabh Garg, Secretary at MoSPI
item.description: MoSPI Secretary Saurabh Garg addresses criticism regarding India’s revised GDP base series, explaining the adoption of double deflation, input-price mapping via Output PPI, and plans for releasing back-series data by late 2026.

item.title: Nabard-backed agri-fintech onboards over 300,000 Kisan credit cards
item.description: NABARD and 24X7 Moneyworks have onboarded over 300,000 Kisan Credit Card (KCC) applications via an eKCC portal, streamlining agricultural loans and eliminating long bank queues for farmers.

item.title: India’s exports to core BRICS surge 34% as trade ties get stronger
item.description: India’s exports to core BRICS economies—Brazil, Russia, China, and South Africa—surged 34% to $19.9 billion in April-August, outpacing the expanded 11-member bloc.

item.title: Record buffer may help prevent spike in pulse prices
item.description: India’s pulses buffer stock hits a record 4.5 million tonnes, exceeding the 3.5 MT norm. The government plans calibrated market releases to manage retail prices amid Kharif crop risks.

item.title: Few takers for microfinance credit guarantee scheme
item.description: The Credit Guarantee Scheme for Microfinance Institutions fell far short of its ₹20,000 crore target, sanctioning only ₹8,500 crore as high fees and risk-averse banks stymied uptake.

item.title: ICAI mandates peer review for PSB branch auditors
item.description: Targets 1-year disposal of disciplinary cases

item.title: ‘Taking sledgehammer to crack a nut’: Tata Trusts’ full statement on Chandra’s reappointment
item.description: Tata Trusts challenges the validity of N. Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, arguing the resolution failed due to lack of majority support from Trust-nominated directors as per the Articles of Association.

item.title: Explainer: What India’s export data and import basket suggest
item.description: India’s merchandise exports jumped 26% in August FY27, led by electronics and engineering. While the import bill is also rising, key capital goods are boosting domestic manufacturing and long-term productive capacity.

item.title: Tata Trusts reject casting vote for Chandra’s reappointment, call resolution invalid
item.description: Tata Trusts challenged the use of a casting vote to validate N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, citing lack of mandatory support from nominee directors and deeming the resolution legally void.

item.title: AI antitrust lawsuit: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Google accused of colluding to slow development
item.description: A lawsuit accuses Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, and Google of illegally coordinating to slow AI development, alleging antitrust violations that limit competition and harm paid AI subscribers.

item.title: Where America’s richest billionaires live: These 5 states dominate Forbes 400 list
item.description: California leads with 85 billionaires in the Forbes 400, followed by New York, Florida, Texas, and Illinois, highlighting a significant concentration of America’s billionaire wealth in just five states.

item.title: Trump’s approval falls to 37% as inflation and Iran conflict weigh on midterm outlook: Report
item.description: President Donald Trump’s approval rating drops to the weakest point of his second term, with decreased support among conservatives and independents as economic concerns and foreign policy issues impact voter sentiment ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Railways clears Rs 133-cr four-lane road over bridge to replace level crossing in Gujarat
item.description: Indian Railways to upgrade Western Railway’s Udhna-Ukai Songadh section with a Rs 133 crore four-lane Road Over Bridge replacing Level Crossing No.53 for smoother traffic and safer rail operations.

item.title: U’khand transfers Rs 18 cr to 10,709 construction worker families ahead of festival season
item.description: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami oversaw the transfer, calling it a festive gift for construction workers.

item.title: Train runs 8 hours 48 minutes late, Railways told to pay Rs 35,000 to passenger
item.description: The train allegedly ran behind schedule. It eventually reached Sambalpur after a delay of 528 minutes, or 8 hours and 48 minutes.

item.title: Railway safety push: What is Electronic Interlocking and which 7 Solapur stations will get it?
item.description: Indian Railways approves a Rs 209 crore Electronic Interlocking project at seven Solapur Division stations to modernize signalling and enhance railway safety infrastructure.

item.title: From ‘hoax’ to ‘AI Force’: Has Trump changed his mind on AI guardrails?
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced plans to create an “AI Force” and appoint a new AI czar while opposing any slowdown in AI development, emphasizing tech dominance amid US-China rivalry.

item.title: From blue economy to AI: K’taka announces Rs 1,420 cr twin policies to drive investment, jobs
item.description: Karnataka aims to turn its 340-km coastline and marine biodiversity into high-value products, companies and intellectual property.

item.title: Indora-Dighori flyover opens in Nagpur: Rs 998-cr project aims to cut travel time to 15 mins
item.description: Nagpur’s new 8.90 km Indora-Dighora flyover, costing Rs 998 crore, reduces travel time from 40-50 minutes to 15 minutes, easing traffic and boosting connectivity across the city.
